## Spark Worker Metrics (first cut)
Cluster-aggregate golden signals for the Worker pool, sourced from Spark's native Prometheus sink (`:8081/metrics/prometheus`) via the existing Prometheus -> OTel Collector -> Dynatrace pipeline (see `observability/prometheus/prometheus.yml`, job `spark-workers`). All 16 worker pods (lab1 + lab2) are summed/averaged here; per-worker drilldown by `kubernetes_pod_name` is a natural next refinement, along with computed utilization percentages once cross-series DQL arithmetic is validated. Metric unit metadata is not settable for OTLP-ingested metrics via the classic API, so most axes show raw values (cores as count, memory in MB).

**Metrics Endpoint Response Time** (bottom-right) is Prometheus's own `scrape_duration_seconds` -- how long it actually took to fetch `/metrics/prometheus` from each worker, via the K8s API-server proxy. Unlike Dynatrace's native Service response-time tracking on the Master/History UI pages (which stayed flat under heavy Spark load in testing), this *does* show real degradation: ~2.3x average, ~20x worst-case, during a real stress test vs. idle (2026-10-01 sample).
